classification.predictive_attribute: Post-Versigent spin complexity discount; Wind River impairment marks software optionality reset

key_assumptions.input: Starting free cash flow per share
key_assumptions.source: FY2025 pro forma post-Versigent: consolidated OCF $2,185M minus capex $656M = $1,529M; remaining segments ~73% of adj. operating income ($1,787M / $2,461M) → ~$1,102M ÷ ~214M diluted shares (10-K FY2025; 8-K spin 2026-04-01)
Post-spin focus on Intelligent Systems + Engineered Components; mid-single-digit volume plus content growth; exit ~15× normalized owner cash

open_questions: Confirm pro forma post-Versigent owner cash **$5.15/sh** allocation (73% of consolidated FCF by segment adj. OI share).
Versigent (VGNT) distributed shares: decide whether to model look-through value separately from remaining APTV.
Wind River impairment: accept embedded_in_segment treatment or require separate software milestone NAV.
Stance **hold** at 18.88% synthesis IRR; promote to **core** only after two quarters of post-spin pro forma margins.
thesis: Aptiv PLC is a global industrial technology supplier to the automotive and adjacent mobility markets. **[Fact]** The company designs and manufactures intelligent sensors, high-performance compute, connection systems, and electrical distribution solutions that enable safer, greener, and more connected vehicles. **[Fact]** After the April 1, 2026 spin-off of Electrical Distribution Systems as Versigent (NYSE: VGNT), remaining Aptiv operates two reportable segments: **Intelligent Systems** (formerly Advanced Safety and User Experience) and **Engineered Components** (connection systems and cable management). **[Fact]** FY2025 consolidated net sales were **$20.4 billion** on a pre-spin basis; post-spin remaining revenue is roughly **$11.6 billion** (Intelligent Systems **$5.8 billion** plus Engineered Components **$5.8 billion** external sales per FY2025 segment note). **[Fact]** Aptiv is incorporated in Jersey, headquartered in Schaffhausen, Switzerland, and trades on the NYSE under APTV (CIK 0001521332).
why_market_wrong: The stock near **$59.86** may still trade as a messy, levered auto-parts conglomerate rather than a slimmer software-and-interconnect franchise after Versigent. **[Inference]** FY2025 GAAP net income collapsed to **$165 million** (from **$1.79 billion** in 2024) after a **$648 million** Wind River goodwill impairment and large deferred-tax movements, while operating cash flow stayed **$2.19 billion**. Screeners focused on earnings per share miss the cash-generation story. **[Inference]** The completed Versigent spin removes the lower-multiple wiring harness mix and **$178 million** of separation costs from the rear-view mirror, but index rebalancing and event-driven sellers may keep a complexity discount into mid-2026. **[Inference]** Intelligent Systems carries embedded edge-software optionality via Wind River after the impairment reset; the market may treat the write-down as proof of failure rather than a cleaned-up balance sheet for software-defined vehicle content growth.
